input.brief: case study: a small senior software crew built a map-first land and homes website with an MLS import for a two-broker real estate firm, live in 27 days; its home page is a surveyor's plat that draws itself

direction.name: The well-kept board
direction.idea: The whole page is a board of tiles fitted edge to edge with narrow gaps, like a tidy desk seen from above. Each tile is one thing: the name, a statement, a photograph, a number, a link, a short list. There is no hero and no sequence of bands; the page is one continuous composition that the eye roams. It suits subjects with many small true things to show (a studio with work, writing, clients and news; a product with several distinct capabilities) and it replaces the generic bento by having real content in every tile and a strict system for sizes.
direction.composition: A 12-column grid with 8px gaps and 8–12px outer margins, filled completely, no empty cells. Tiles use only four sizes (for example 6×4, 6×2, 3×2, 3×4 in column × row units of about 90px). Every tile is a flat filled rectangle: ground colour one step from the page, or a palette colour, or a photograph covering it. One radius everywhere (0, or 6–10px). The first screen contains: a name tile (the name at display size, the largest type on the page) with the wordmark set large, a statement tile with the description at 28–40px, two or three image tiles and one action tile in the accent colour. Text inside tiles is top-left aligned with 20–24px padding and never centred. Below the first screen the board continues with the same sizes; the last row is the footer made of tiles.
direction.typography: One grotesk in two weights. Inside tiles: a large size for single statements, a small size for lists. No uppercase labels in tile corners.
direction.colour: Page ground, tile ground one step lighter or darker, and one or two palette colours on selected tiles. Photographs supply the rest.
direction.imagery: Photographs fill whole tiles with `object-fit: cover`; choose images that crop well to both wide and tall tiles.
direction.richness: The fit. A full board with consistent gaps and varied tile contents is satisfying in the way a packed suitcase is.
direction.pitfalls: Tiles are filled, never outlined, and never carry shadows. Do not put an icon and a two-line feature blurb in every tile; vary what tiles hold. Decide the phone layout as its own board: two columns, tiles re-ordered so the name and statement lead.

hero.name: Name band and rails
hero.blueprint: One viewport filled completely with tiles on 8px gaps and 8px margins. Across the top, a band tile 170px tall holds the name on one line at clamp(140px, 14.4vw, 220px), heavy, tracking -0.04em, centred and deliberately wider than the band so both ends are cropped by the tile's edges (overflow: hidden, white-space: nowrap). Under it a row of four equal tiles, 64px tall, each holding one text link at 16px, top-left aligned. The remaining 62% of the height is three columns. Left rail (columns 1-2): two stacked tiles, a portrait photograph above and a short list of five facts below. Centre (columns 3-10): one large photograph tile, object-fit: cover, with a statement tile in the ground tone laid along its bottom third holding one sentence at clamp(24px, 2.4vw, 36px), top-left aligned on 24px padding. Right rail (columns 11-12): a full-height stack of five flat colour tiles, a light-to-dark run from the palette; the lowest takes the accent colour and holds the single action, the others each carry one short fact at 15px.
hero.mobile: Tiles restack in two columns with 6px gaps. The name band stays full width: 26vw type cropped at both sides in a 110px band. The four link tiles become a two-by-two block. The large photograph tile follows at full width, 4:3, with the statement tile under it at 6vw. The colour rail becomes a horizontal row of five short tiles, the action tile last and twice as wide.
hero.headline: The name on one cropped line, any length, plus one sentence of up to 60 characters in the statement tile.

photos.title: Fog and quiet
photos.note: misty, muted, minimal landscapes and empty horizons; calm areas for text

photos.alt: Stone jetty stretching into still water and dense grey fog
Wooden deck and a single rock disappearing into thick fog
Tiny sailboat on a calm sea with distant hills, black and white
Layered hill ridges fading into warm beige mist
Small island on a pale, glassy sea beneath soft clouds
Three ships on a distant horizon across a calm blue sea
Still misty water fading into a soft pink-grey sky

motion.name: Edge-to-edge marquee
motion.description: One line of very large type travels sideways across the full width at a slow constant speed, as a band between two sections or as the closing statement. Linear timing, duplicated content for a seamless loop, paused on hover and under reduced motion. One marquee per page, carrying real words (the name, the claim), never a list of buzzwords.

sections.name: Lead line over four columns
sections.blueprint: Two parts on one 12-column grid with 20px margins. First, a lead paragraph of 30–40 words spans all 12 columns at clamp(22px, 2.2vw, 32px), regular weight, leading 1.2: three lines that read as the opening of a text, with no heading before it. 72px below, four equal columns (three grid columns each, 24px gutters) carry small text at 14–15px with leading 1.45. Each column is one paragraph of 40–70 words that opens with a bold run-in phrase of two or three words in full ink, the rest continuing on the same line in the soft ink. Columns top-align and end ragged at different depths. No cards, icons or dividers; the bold run-ins are the only markers. The four columns answer four plain questions: who, what, where, how to reach them. Padding is modest, 96px top and bottom, so a sheet of images can start straight after.
sections.mobile: The lead paragraph at 20px, full width. The four columns become a two-by-two grid with a 20px gutter and 40px row gap at 14px; if any paragraph exceeds 60 words, switch to one column with 32px between paragraphs. Run-in phrases stay bold.

sections.name: Live demo with controls
sections.blueprint: One filled panel, 680–760px wide and about 640px tall, radius 12px, in a tone clearly darker or lighter than the ground, placed on the text column's left edge or centred, with at least 15vh of empty ground above and below. The panel is split 62/38 into two flat areas that differ by one tone. Left area: the product doing its job on real content at true size. Right area: a narrow column of working controls, six to nine stacked rows 44px tall, each with a name at 14px on the left and a slider, toggle or value on the right; changing one changes the demonstration at once. A text link sits in the panel's bottom-left corner. The heading, two to four words at 24–32px, sits above the panel on its left edge with one sentence at 16px; under the panel, one line of start instruction.
sections.mobile: The panel fills the width. The demonstration takes the top at 4:3; the controls follow beneath as full-width rows 52px tall, only the four most telling ones, with a text link that reveals the rest. Heading and sentence sit above at 24px and 16px.

sections.name: Many into one
sections.blueprint: A diagram drawn with one repeated shape instead of arrows. The heading (two to four words on two lines at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px)) and a short paragraph at 17px sit in columns 1–4. Beneath, a wide inline SVG spans columns 1–12 at about 4.5:1. It is built from 120–160 small filled squares (or the page's own motif), each 10–14px. In the left third they are scattered loosely in two pale tones. In the middle third they are pulled into a tight horizontal ribbon three squares high. In the right third they fan out again into neat, evenly spaced rows in the accent colour. The eye reads disorder, compression, order, from left to right. Under the diagram, three text columns aligned to its thirds: a bold one-word name at 20px and two lines at 16px each; the words carry the sequence ('Gather', 'Reduce', 'Release'). No connecting marks.
sections.mobile: The diagram turns to run top to bottom: a 3:4 SVG with the scatter at the top, the ribbon as a vertical band in the middle and the ordered rows at the bottom. The three names and their text sit to its right in a 38vw column, each level with its zone.

sections.name: Day tabs, banded agenda
sections.blueprint: A two-line heading at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px), first line in the soft ink and second in full ink, with the booking button on the same row at the far right. 56px below, left: a 150px column of stacked day tabs, each a filled block 150 by 64px with 6px gaps showing the weekday at 16px and the date at 13px; the active tab takes the darkest fill with inverted text. Right, from 190px to the right margin: the day's sessions as alternating tone bands, each 76px tall with an 8px radius and 4px gaps, the two tones one step apart. Inside a band, on fixed column starts: the time at 20px with tabular figures, 20px from the left; the title at 18px in medium weight at 22%, with a one-line note at 13px in the soft ink under it; speaker names right-aligned at 14px beside up to three overlapping 32px round portraits.
sections.mobile: The heading stacks above a full-width button. Day tabs become a horizontal row of equal filled blocks, sticky under the top edge. Each band stacks time over title over speakers with 16px padding and grows to fit; portraits sit at the band's top-right corner.

sections.name: Stepped figure tiles
sections.blueprint: Three figures on three tiles that refuse to line up. A tall tile in the accent colour fills columns 1–6 and is 70vh high; it holds one figure at clamp(56px, 5.4vw, 92px) in its top-left corner, 28px in, and its caption at 17px in its bottom-left corner, with empty colour between. On the right, an ink-coloured tile in columns 7–9 starts 14vh lower and is 44vh high: a paper-coloured figure top-left, a caption along its bottom edge. A third tile in a mid tone takes columns 10–12, starts 26vh down and is 34vh high, with the same internal layout. Gaps are 8px. The unequal heights leave notches of bare ground above and below the right-hand tiles; the heading, two to four words at 28–36px, sits in the upper notch on column 7. If the page has a motif, cut one corner of each tile to its geometry with clip-path.
sections.mobile: The tall tile comes first, at full width and 56vw high, with its figure at 15vw. The two smaller tiles follow side by side with a 6px gap, the right one starting 32px lower than the left, each with its figure at 11vw and its caption at the bottom. The heading sits above at 26px.

sections.name: Wide photo, colour tile, facts
sections.blueprint: Top: a heading of two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px) on the left margin, then 24px below it a three-line lead paragraph at 21–22px across columns 1–6. 72px lower, two tiles sit side by side with a 16px gap. The left tile spans columns 1–8: a landscape photograph at 16:10 with one radius (0 or 10px). A short paragraph of up to 35 words at 16px is set in a solid paper-colour block 320px wide with 20px padding, placed over the photograph's top-right corner and flush with both edges. The right tile spans columns 9–12 and is a flat palette colour, 60% of the photograph's height: it holds a simple inline SVG outline of the region or the floor plan as one filled shape, with one solid dot marking the location. Under the colour tile, four label and value pairs at 14px in a two-by-two grid: altitude, distance, season, local time.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9vw, lead at 18px. The photograph goes full width at 4:3 and its overlaid paragraph moves beneath it as ordinary text. The colour tile follows at full width and 3:2, and the four label and value pairs sit under it in two columns.

sections.name: The action tile
sections.blueprint: The close is one row of the board. Three filled tiles sit side by side with 8–14px gaps, all 360px tall and sharing one radius: a wide centre tile spanning columns 3–10 in the accent colour, flanked by two narrow tiles (columns 1–2 and 11–12) that run off the left and right viewport edges, as if the row had been cropped from a longer one. The centre tile holds, left-aligned and vertically centred with 40px padding: a heading of three to five words at 40px, two lines at 17px, and the action. The action is either one rectangular button or an email field 420px wide in the paper colour with the submit button nested inside its right end. The flanking tiles hold no text: one is a photograph covering the tile, the other a flat palette colour. No shadows, no outlines.
sections.mobile: The accent tile runs full width, about 300px tall, heading at 28px, field and button stacked at full width. The two flanking tiles follow beneath as a pair, each half width and 120px tall, with the same gap and the same radius.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: Realevate
references.idea: The site is a board you zoom out of: the home screen with its slogan marquee becomes one tile beneath four tall colour-coded category cards.
references.hero: White field, all type navy. Top row about 8% down: one link far left, an extended-caps wordmark centred, one link far right. Across the vertical middle a two-word slogan repeats as a marquee at about 15vw in medium weight, cropped by both edges; a square photograph about 19vw wide sits dead centre on top of it, hiding the letters behind. Lower third: a two-line centred subhead near 24px and, beneath it, a thin-outlined rectangular tag in tiny extended capitals. Bottom-left a copyright line; bottom-right an outlined rectangular button beside a solid navy square menu button.
references.type: Google Sans medium at 218px with -0.02em tracking for the marquee and roughly 16-24px for interface text. Monument Extended in small spaced capitals for the wordmark and price tag. Card titles are rotated 90 degrees and read bottom to top.
references.colour: #ffffff #1e2a5e #e1e2ea #3a664f #2c1a2e #1c1b1e — Navy on white with no other interface colour in the hero. The overview sits on pale lavender-grey and gives each category a flat card colour: navy, forest green, aubergine, near-black.
references.imagery: Glossy architectural renders of sea-view terraces, resorts and towers. One perfect square in the hero; landscape crops fill the bottom third of each category card. Square corners, full saturation, no grade.
references.layout: A one-screen site with two states. Home is symmetrical: corners hold small utilities, the centre holds marquee and image. The overview is a four-column row of tall cards with equal gutters and a scaled-down live copy of the home screen centred beneath.

sections.description: Pale lavender-grey ground with four equal portrait cards in a row, roughly 1:2 in proportion, about 20px apart with generous outer margins. Each card is a flat colour block for its top 70% and a photograph for the bottom 30%. A small monogram sits top-left; the category name runs vertically up the right side in white at about 28px; a two-line descriptor in tiny white text sits bottom-left of the colour block, just above the image.

Centred below the card row, spanning the middle two columns, sits a miniature of the home screen: a white rectangle with the tiny nav row, the slogan marquee still running and the square photo in the middle, cropped by the viewport's bottom edge. It acts as a live thumbnail of where the visitor came from and a way back.

steal: Run a giant slogan marquee through the middle of the viewport and park a square image on top so the words are read as they pass around the picture.
Build category cards as a tall colour block over a short photo, with the title rotated up the right edge.
Keep utilities in the four corners (two links top, copyright bottom-left, action pair bottom-right) and leave the sides empty.

references.name: Justin Lerner
references.idea: The portfolio is a hairline grid of square cells in which the letters of the owner's name are scattered among small animated project emblems, so name and work form one crossword-like board.
references.hero: White page divided by pale grey hairlines into five columns of exact squares (each 20vw), so three full rows and a sliver of a fourth show. No header, navigation or text block. Each cell holds one centred object about half the cell wide: either a single black slab-serif capital at 5.6vw (one in the top-left cell, one top-right, three more scattered through rows two and three) or a small project emblem such as a pixel speech bubble, a photographed bowl, a red robot arm, a wireframe figure, a logo badge or a line-drawn building. One cell holds only a soft blurred cloud. About 90% of the area is white.
references.type: Museo Slab is the only face on desktop: weight-500 capitals at 80px used as grid letters, with no body copy at all (eleven words on the page). Mobile adds light italic slab project names and small sans year tabs.
references.colour: #ffffff #e9eae8 #111111 #fff200 #f0563a #4fd0c8 — White ground, grey hairlines, black letters. Colour arrives only in the emblems, each in its own one- or two-colour scheme (yellow, coral, teal, purple). Mobile adds two solid yellow icon tiles.
references.imagery: Small spot illustrations and logos in deliberately mixed styles (pixel art, line drawing, isometric, wireframe mesh, one cut-out photo), each centred in a square cell with no frame or background, and animated.
references.layout: A single edge-to-edge grid of 20vw squares with hairline dividers and no outer margin; the whole site is about 1.3 screens. Mobile switches to two columns and adds a year tab in each cell's top-right corner and an italic name under each emblem.

sections.description: The grid continues for one more row below the fold with five cells holding only emblems. Across frames the emblems are caught in different states: a logo badge collapsing to a small monogram, a scan line moving down the wireframe figure, a pencil travelling across a drawn face, a coin appearing and disappearing. Each cell is a tiny looping or hover-driven animation, with no captions on desktop.

Mobile header built from the same cells: a small square with the initial on crosshair lines at left, an empty cell, then two solid-yellow square tiles carrying a document icon and a paper-plane icon. Below, the two-column grid gives each project a boxed year tab notched into the top-right corner of its cell and an italic slab project name near the bottom, sometimes overlapping the emblem.

steal: Spell the name by dropping its letters into scattered cells of a hairline grid and fill the remaining cells with project marks, so identity and index share one structure.
Give each project a single small animated emblem centred in a large empty square instead of a screenshot thumbnail.
On mobile, notch a small boxed year tab into the corner of each grid cell and label the cell with an italic name at its base.

references.name: Nodeck
references.idea: A consultancy that claims to sell thinking rather than slides builds its site as a slide deck anyway, complete with prev/next buttons, a slide counter and presenter notes.
references.hero: Flat bubblegum-pink viewport. Centre: the name as a sticker, white ultra-heavy caps with a thick black outline and offset black extrusion, bent along a gentle arc and slightly rotated, about 72% wide and 30% tall. A two-word caps label sits 80px above it; a two-line caps tagline at ~1.1vw sits below, two of its words swiped in fluorescent yellow. Photographic props crop off the corners: a yellow sticky note top-left and a highlighter pen entering top-right whose tip touches the last letter. Bottom edge is deck chrome: notes link left; previous, round lime menu and next buttons with hard black offset shadows centred; mute icon and slide counter right.
references.type: The wordmark is an SVG sticker in ultra-black caps. Slide titles use BN Dime Display, a fat irregular display sans, uppercase at ~7vw. Everything else is DM Sans uppercase at 14 to 16px regular. Two sizes, a sevenfold jump.
references.colour: #ff87ab #f5e4d6 #000000 #ffffff #def915 #e9d68b — Each slide is a flat field, pink then cream, with black type; fluorescent lime-yellow is the action and highlight colour (menu button, highlighter swipes, transition wipes). Warm and saturated.
references.imagery: Top-down cut-out photos of desk stationery (sticky note, highlighter, pink eraser) with soft shadows, cropped by the viewport corners and positioned to touch the type. Otherwise type only.
references.layout: One fixed full-viewport stage per slide rather than a scrolling page: a centred title or statement in the middle, a small logo sticker pinned top-centre after slide one, and a persistent control bar along the bottom edge. Ten slides.

sections.description: Every slide opens on a cream full-viewport title card carrying only a tiny caps slide-number label and, about 20px beneath it, the slide's title in fat black display caps at ~7vw, centred slightly above the middle. The title rises from behind a mask, then gives way to the slide body on the same stage. A fluorescent yellow brush-stroke band wipes across the screen between slides.

A pink stage with the small sticker logo pinned top-centre and a pink eraser photograph cropped near the top-right corner. A tiny caps slide label sits at one third height; body copy then builds in word by word in heavy caps starting from the left margin at mid-height. The deck controls stay fixed along the bottom edge throughout, with the counter advancing.

steal: Borrow another medium's chrome (deck controls, slide counter, presenter notes) as the site's navigation to make the brand's argument.
Crop real desk objects off the viewport corners and let one physically touch the wordmark so photo and type share a scene.
Use a highlighter swipe both as text emphasis and as the full-screen transition wipe, tying a small detail to the large motion.
